common.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to proceed with this deletion?
common.confirm_post: Are you sure you want to post this transaction? Posted transactions update inventory and general ledger immediately.
common.name: Name

dashboard.title: Executive Financial Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Real-time key performance indicators, cash flow, and operational balances
dashboard.no_low_stock: All product stock levels are healthy

customers.title: Customer Management
customers.subtitle: Track trade debtors, client profiles, statements, and aging analysis

suppliers.title: Supplier Management
suppliers.subtitle: Manage vendors, procurement history, balances, and payable aging

inventory.title: Products & Stock Management
inventory.subtitle: Manage inventory items, valuation, physical counts, stock receipts, and movements
inventory.workflow_hint: Workflow: draft → submit → independent approval → posting. The person who counted cannot approve their own count.

transfers.dispatch_hint: Dispatch deducts from the source store only — the company-wide total stays unchanged until the goods are received.
transfers.partial_hint: Partial receipt is allowed: enter the quantities actually received per line.
transfers.company_stock_note: Transfers never create or destroy company inventory.
transfers.receive_lines_hint: Enter received quantities (0 to keep in transit):

inventory.opening_stock_hint: Opening stock is recorded into the default store's ledger with a full movement history.

sales.title: Sales & Billing
sales.subtitle: Generate quotations, process sales orders, issue invoices, and manage credit notes
sales.restock_items: Return items back to warehouse stock?
sales.walk_in_hint: No customer name needed; the sale is settled immediately. Credit sales require an identified customer.
sales.credit_customer_hint: A credit sale requires an identified customer.
sales.base_total_note: Ledger amounts are converted to the base currency at this rate; the original amount and rate are preserved.
sales.auto_post_hint: Saved as PAID: JENESIS posts the sale and records the real receipt at once, and deducts store stock.
sales.already_paid: Invoice {number} is already paid. Nothing was recorded.
sales.settle_hint: Record the outstanding payment and mark this document PAID (F2).
sales.payment_on_creation_hint: The sale is recorded as PAID with a real receipt. There is no PAID/UNPAID choice.
sales.discard_message: The invoice you started has not been saved. Closing the form will discard it.

purchases.title: Purchases & Vendor Bills
purchases.subtitle: Process purchase orders, supplier bills, stock receipts, and purchase returns
purchases.receipt_hint: Stock increases ONLY when a goods receipt is posted — never when creating products, orders or bills.
purchases.already_paid: Bill {number} is already paid. Nothing was recorded.
purchases.settle_hint: Record the outstanding payment and mark this bill PAID (F2).
purchases.payment_on_creation_hint: The bill is recorded as PAID with a real supplier payment. There is no PAID/UNPAID choice.
purchases.discard_message: The bill you started has not been saved. Closing the form will discard it.

banking.title: Payments & Banking
banking.subtitle: Cash registers, commercial bank accounts, mobile money wallets, and transfers
banking.explanation_hint: An explanation is required whenever counted cash differs from expected cash. A discrepancy never posts an automatic accounting adjustment.
banking.no_auto_adjust_note: No automatic accounting adjustment: discrepancies stay documented for independent approval.
banking.cash_hint: Denomination-based counting compares the physical cash with expected cash (opening + receipts − payouts of the period).
banking.reverse_confirm: Reverse this payment? Its journal entry and all balances will be restored and the reversal audited.
banking.approval_note: The person who closed the session cannot approve it — an independent approver is required.
banking.settle_fx_diff: Settle document fully — post FX difference
banking.settle_fx_hint: The base-currency difference between the document balance and this payment is posted to FX gain (4800) / FX loss (5900).

accounting.title: General Ledger & Accounting
accounting.subtitle: Double-entry accounting engine, chart of accounts, and manual journal entries
accounting.out_of_balance: Entries are out of balance by

reports.title: Financial Reports & Statements
reports.subtitle: Audited trial balance, profit & loss, balance sheet, cash flows, and tax summaries
reports.balance_check: Accounting Equation Check: Assets = Liabilities + Equity

settings.title: System Settings & Administration
settings.subtitle: Company profile, user permissions, tax configurations, audit trails, and backups
settings.backup_desc: Export a full cryptographic backup of all company records, financial ledger, and inventory in JSON format.
settings.restore_desc: Upload a verified backup file to restore system state.
settings.reset_demo_desc: Cleans current database and reloads default demonstration company, sample chart of accounts, and inventory.
settings.restore_invalid_file: The selected file is not a valid backup
settings.restore_warning: Restoring replaces this company's current business data with the backup. Make sure you have chosen the correct file.
settings.restore_signout_notice: After the restore every user is signed out and must sign in again with their existing password.
settings.restore_done: Backup restored. Please sign in again.
settings.require_goods_receipt_hint: When enabled, a supplier bill can only be posted against a posted goods receipt — stock never increases without formal receiving.
settings.valuation_hint: FIFO consumes the oldest purchase layers; weighted average uses the moving average cost.
settings.base_locked: The base currency cannot be deactivated or removed
settings.fx_revaluation_hint: Restates open foreign-currency invoices and bills at the effective rate of the chosen date. Unrealized differences are posted to accounts 4810 / 5910; original booking rates are preserved.
settings.appearance_subtitle: Choose Light Mode or Dark Mode for every screen of JENESIS
settings.theme_dark_desc: Dark workspace for low light and long sessions
settings.theme_system_desc: Follow the appearance setting of this computer
settings.theme_applies_now: The theme is applied immediately — no restart needed.
settings.theme_persist_note: Your choice is saved on this computer and stays active after closing and reopening JENESIS.

auth.login_intro: Enter your JENESIS username and password.
auth.setup_intro: Create the company and the first administrator account. This step is available only once.
auth.password_hint: At least 10 characters. Do not use your username.
auth.change_password_intro: Your password must be changed before you can use JENESIS.
auth.unavailable_title: JENESIS cannot reach its local service
auth.unavailable_intro: The accounting service did not respond. Close JENESIS and start it again. If the problem continues, check the log file in your JENESIS data folder.

errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.COMPANY_FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this company.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: The account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_MATCHES_USERNAME: The password must not be the same as the username.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: The password must not be a single repeated character.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You must change your password before continuing.
errors.USERNAME_INVALID: The username must be 3–40 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.SELF_LOCKOUT: You cannot remove your own administrator rights or disable your own account.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active administrator must remain.
errors.ROLE_INVALID: The selected role is not valid.
errors.RESET_DISABLED: Resetting the database from the interface is disabled. Use a backup and restore instead.
errors.NO_COMPANY: No company record exists. Restart JENESIS to initialise the database.
errors.MISSING_FIELDS: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.USER_CREATE_FAILED: The user could not be created.
errors.USER_UPDATE_FAILED: The user could not be updated.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested record was not found.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Insufficient stock for this operation. Check the available quantities per store.
errors.ALREADY_POSTED: This document has already been posted. Duplicate posting is blocked.
errors.ALREADY_REVERSED: This record has already been reversed.
errors.NOTHING_TO_REVERSE: There is no journal entry to reverse for this record.
errors.FULLY_CREDITED: This invoice has already been fully credited. Duplicate credit notes are blocked.
errors.OVER_RETURN: The return quantity exceeds the still-returnable quantity of the invoice.
errors.OVER_REFUND: This refund would exceed the amount the invoice allows.
errors.CN_NEEDS_POSTED_INVOICE: Credit notes can only be issued against posted invoices.
errors.WALKIN_IMMEDIATE_PAYMENT: Walk-in sales must be paid immediately. For a credit sale, use an identified customer.
errors.NOT_WALKIN: This invoice is not a walk-in sale.
errors.NO_CASH_ACCOUNT: No active cash account is configured for walk-in sales.
errors.GRN_REQUIRED: This company requires a posted goods receipt before a supplier invoice can be posted. Receive the goods first, then link the receipt to the bill.
errors.GRN_NOT_POSTED: The linked goods receipt is not posted.
errors.OVER_RECEIPT: The receipt exceeds the ordered or already-received quantities.
errors.PO_CANCELLED: Goods cannot be received against a cancelled purchase order.
errors.NOTHING_TO_RECEIVE: Nothing to receive: all lines are already fully received.
errors.SERVICE_NOT_STOCKABLE: Only goods can be received into stock or transferred between stores (services have no stock).
errors.COUNT_SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve a count that you created or submitted. An independent reviewer must approve it.
errors.CASH_SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve a cash reconciliation that you closed. An independent approver is required.
errors.COUNT_NOT_SUBMITTED: Only submitted counts can be approved or rejected.
errors.COUNT_NOT_DRAFT: Only draft or rejected counts can be edited or submitted.
errors.COUNT_NOT_APPROVED: Only approved counts can be posted.
errors.SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN: A cash session is already open for this account. Close it first.
errors.SESSION_NOT_CASH_ACCOUNT: Cash sessions can only be opened on CASH-type accounts.
errors.SESSION_NOT_OPEN: Only open cash sessions can be closed.
errors.SESSION_NOT_CLOSED: Only closed cash sessions can be approved.
errors.VARIANCE_EXPLANATION_REQUIRED: An explanation is required when counted cash differs from expected cash.
errors.TRANSFER_SAME_STORE: Source and destination stores must be different.
errors.TRANSFER_SAME_ACCOUNT: Source and destination accounts must be different.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DRAFT: Only draft transfers can be dispatched or cancelled.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DISPATCHED: Only dispatched (in-transit) transfers can be received.
errors.NEGATIVE_QUANTITY: Quantities must be greater than zero.
errors.DEFAULT_STORE_LOCKED: The default store cannot be deactivated. Choose another default store first.
errors.STORE_HAS_STOCK: This store still holds stock. Transfer the stock out before deactivating it.
errors.BASE_CURRENCY_LOCKED: The base currency cannot be deactivated.
errors.NO_EXCHANGE_RATE: No exchange rate is configured for this currency pair on that date.
errors.INVALID_RATE: The exchange rate must be greater than zero.
errors.INVALID_CURRENCY_CODE: The currency code must be 3 letters (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, RWF.
errors.CURRENCY_NOT_CONFIGURED: This currency is not configured for the company. Add it in Settings → Currencies.
errors.INVALID_DECIMALS: Currency decimals must be between 0 and 4.
errors.INVALID_STORE_CODE: The store code must be 2–20 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.INVALID_DATE: The date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
errors.SAME_CURRENCY_PAIR: A rate must link two different currencies.
errors.UNBALANCED_JOURNAL: Unbalanced journal entry: total debits must equal total credits.
errors.CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: A customer is required. For an anonymous cash sale, enable walk-in mode.
errors.FX_SETTLE_REQUIRES_DOCUMENT: FX settlement requires a linked invoice or bill.
errors.FX_SETTLE_BASE_CURRENCY: FX settlement requires a foreign-currency payment.
errors.FX_ACCOUNTS_MISSING: FX gain/loss accounts (4800/5900) are missing for this company.
errors.FX_REVALUATION_EXISTS: A revaluation has already been posted for this date.
errors.NO_FX_EXPOSURE: No open foreign-currency balances to revalue.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.hint: Keyboard: digits, + − * / , Enter or = , Backspace, C, Esc. The calculator never posts transactions.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.settle: Settle (mark PAID) the selected sales or purchase document
shortcuts.print: Print the selected document or report
shortcuts.refresh: Reload the data on this screen
shortcuts.new: Create a new document on this screen
shortcuts.theme: Cycle the theme: Light → Dark → System
shortcuts.language: Switch the interface language (English → Français → Kinyarwanda)
shortcuts.reference: Show or hide this shortcut reference
shortcuts.back: Go back to the previous screen
shortcuts.forward: Go forward to the next screen
shortcuts.escape: Close the dialog, then the panel, then go back (never quits JENESIS)
shortcuts.print_none: There is nothing to print on this screen.
shortcuts.settle_none: Select a sales or purchase document first, then press F2 to settle it.
shortcuts.hint: Shortcuts are suspended while you type, except function keys, Esc and Alt/Shift combinations.
shortcuts.no_history_back: There is no screen to go back to.
shortcuts.no_history_forward: There is no next screen yet.

messenger.title: Messenger
messenger.send_hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter adds a line
messenger.empty_thread: No message in this conversation yet.
messenger.discard_message: You have not sent your message. Closing Messenger will discard it.
messenger.load_error: The conversation could not be loaded.
messenger.send_error: The message could not be sent.
messenger.forbidden: You are not allowed to use Messenger.

help.footer_note: JENESIS keeps every document in a balanced double-entry ledger. When in doubt, print the Trial Balance.
